title: Hobby
summary: HOB'BY, noun A kind of hawk; a hawk of the lure. HOB'BY, noun 1. A strong active horse, of a middle size, said to have been originally from Ireland; a nag; a pacing horse; a garran. 2. A stick, or fig

inlines.v: HOB'BY, noun A kind of hawk; a hawk of the lure. HOB'BY, noun 1. A strong active horse, of a middle size, said to have been originally from Ireland; a nag; a pacing horse; a garran. 2. A stick, or figure of a horse, on which boys ride. 3. Any favorite object; that which a person pursues with zeal or delight. 4. A stupid fellow.
